search_surface: GitHub REST repository search metadata (subject to verified availability)

fixed_request_parameters.authentication: record whether anonymous or authenticated; never publish a token

before_opening_any_new_repository_source: Capture exact raw response bytes, UTC request/response times, full result order and response SHA-256 for every fixed query/page; record total_count, incomplete_results, HTTP status and any truncation/rate limit.
Collect owner/repo, repository URL, fork flag, default branch, last update, and pinned HEAD SHA by a metadata-only GitHub ref/commit endpoint for every result; record unavailable refs and timing.
Save a dated immutable search-result manifest with a hash and link this precommit and development snapshot. Preserve duplicated results and original ranks across queries.
If a query/page or required HEAD metadata cannot be captured faithfully, record failure and stop the held-out claim; do not replace it with hand-picked repositories.

eligibility_after_manifest.selection_target: up to four unrelated, pair-eligible public projects
eligibility_after_manifest.selection_sort: ascending lexicographic SHA-256 of lowercase owner/repo@pinned_commit
eligibility_after_manifest.pair_task: at least two inspectable declared numeric scalar metrics or reproducible aggregate definitions with versioned SQL/dbt source
eligibility_after_manifest.event_task: an inspectable adjacent parent-child commit; event ineligibility does not remove a pair-eligible project
eligibility_after_manifest.no_outcome_selection: Do not require a positive, matching values, successful build, or supported syntax. Record all rejections, forks, mirrors, shared datasets, unsupported cases and replacement steps.

human_evaluation_budget.classification_sample: up to 25 pairs and 10 adjacent events per selected project by frozen strata/hashes
human_evaluation_budget.retrieval: exact Recall@k only for completely judged anchor universes; no top-25 proxy
human_evaluation_budget.judgments: two independent domain-capable humans and a third adjudicator on disagreements, blinded to method predictions

holdout_gate: The current method is GTM-specific; no new repository source will be opened until a generic adapter and its development-only checks are fixed and a complete search-result manifest exists.
